message.content:
Rebuild the admin SETTINGS page into a comprehensive, tabbed customization hub for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
- Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` (areas: billing, platform). Design: `.card`,`.input`,`.btn-*`,`.table-shell`; `import { PageHeader, Badge } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`.
- Persistence: a `Setting { key, value }` key/value model exists (`db.setting`). READ the current `app/admin/settings/page.tsx` to see how settings are currently read/written, and mirror/extend it.
- READ FIRST: `app/admin/settings/page.tsx` (you EDIT it), `app/admin/staff/page.tsx` + `components/admin/StaffRoleControls.tsx` (staff manager to mount), and note `components/admin/EmailTemplateEditor.tsx` (provided by another agent — you IMPORT it; it may not exist yet during your run, which is fine — it resolves at final build).

## TASK — deep dive, maximum customization
Turn settings into a tabbed hub (`?tab=` or client tabs) reading/writing the `Setting` store via a typed helper you create, `lib/settings.ts` (`getSetting(key, default)`, `setSetting`, `getAllSettings`, plus a `SETTINGS_DEFAULTS` map). Tabs:
1. **General / Branding** — platform name, tagline, support email, company legal name + address, social links, footer text.
2. **Billing** — currency, tax %, min top-up, default term, invoice number prefix, dunning grace/warn/terminate days, auto-suspend toggle.
3. **Domains** — registrar markup %, WHOIS-privacy default.
4. **Dedicated IP** — monthly price, low-pool auto-replenish threshold.
5. **Provisioning & limits** — default plan, max servers/user, signup free-credit cents, maintenance-mode toggle + message.
6. **Growth** — referral reward cents, coupons enabled.
7. **Email & SMTP** — SMTP host/port/user/pass/from/secure; AND mount the email-template editor here: `import { EmailTemplateEditor } from "@/components/admin/EmailTemplateEditor"` and render it in this tab.
8. **Security** — enforce staff 2FA toggle, session length (days), login rate-limit max, allowed admin IPs (comma list).
9. **Feature flags** — enable/disable: game servers, Claude builder, domains, newsletter, referrals.
10. **Staff & roles** — mount the existing staff manager: fetch users server-side (mirror `app/admin/staff/page.tsx`'s query) and render `<StaffRoleControls .../>` with the same props it currently receives.
Each save via `lib/actions-settings.ts` (`"use server"`: `saveSettings(section, formData)` → writes the relevant `Setting` rows; `requireArea("platform")`, or `"billing"` for billing/domains/dedicated-IP tabs). Password/secret fields never echo stored values back. Use `components/admin/SettingsTabs.tsx` + per-section panels under `components/admin/settings/`.

## OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
CREATE: `lib/settings.ts`, `lib/actions-settings.ts`, `components/admin/SettingsTabs.tsx`, `components/admin/settings/*.tsx` (per-section panels). EDIT (sole owner): `app/admin/settings/page.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config, layouts, lib/db.ts, lib/rbac.ts, lib/mailer.ts, `app/admin/staff/**`, `app/admin/email-templates/**`, `components/admin/StaffRoleControls.tsx`, `components/admin/EmailTemplateEditor.tsx` (you only IMPORT these last two), worker/*, ROADMAP, docs/**, sitemap, or files not in your list. Do NOT run build/prisma-push/generate/restart. No commits, no new deps. `"use server"` = async-only.

## REPORT
Files created/edited; the full settings taxonomy you implemented; confirm you mounted the email-template editor + staff manager in tabs; INTEGRATION NEEDED (note that the old top-level `/admin/email-templates` and `/admin/staff` nav entries should be removed since they now live in Settings; and which settings keys the app should start reading, e.g. dunning days, markup, feature flags); risks.

26	  analytics: ["ADMIN"],
27	  clients: ["SUPPORT", "ADMIN"],
28	  support: ["SUPPORT", "ADMIN"],
